protocol.retraining: Independent dataset and full fit per seed, including calibration and selection
protocol.matched_target: Raw paper policy validation recall at 0.3, same target and largest feasible threshold for both methods
protocol.calibration_selection: Positive sigmoid slope and lower selection-partition Brier loss; otherwise retain raw probabilities
protocol.classification_control: Both methods maximize F1 on identical unique validation-score operating points, highest threshold breaks ties; baseline retains paper threshold 0.5
protocol.high_cutoff: Map raw 0.7 through fitted monotone calibrator to isolate identical block decisions
protocol.aggregation: Five prespecified runs; means/sample standard deviations/ranges, not population confidence intervals

limitations: All labels remain synthetic and reflect the same generator.
Independent retraining seeds do not establish cross-organization validity.
Matching validation recall is not a guarantee of equal test recall; both outcomes are disclosed.
Monotone calibration does not change ranking; matched policy decisions can be identical.
Reliability/ECE depend on fixed bin definitions and finite sample counts.
This study never chooses a deployment model or threshold from held-out scores.
